2609.33855.title: Program-Verified Self-Evolution for Vision-Language Models
2609.33855.paper_summary: Self-evolving vision-language models train on questions they generate from unlabeled images. Since these questions have no gold answers, prior methods label them by majority vote over sampled answers or by a model judge. In a human evaluation, we find that 24\% of majority-vote labels and 18\% of model-judge labels produced during self-evolution are wrong. To address this problem, we present Verifiable QA Generation for Self-Evolving Models (VQS), which changes how the model judges answers. Instead of voting on an answer, the model parses each image into a structured record, such as a scene graph, a chart table, or a diagram graph. Fixed programs then write a question from the record and compute its answer. The model still acts as a visual checker, but it only confirms the individual facts the program reads, one short claim at a time. These claim-level checks select the parser's training targets, so the parser also improves without labels. Human raters find 94\% of VQS answers correct, against 76\% for majority voting. Across ten benchmarks, VQS improves Qwen3-VL by up to 3.18 points at the 2B, 4B, and 8B scales and outperforms the strongest self-evolving baseline at each. Gains keep growing over three training rounds, reaching 3.84 points at 2B. Code is released at https://github.com/ahmedheakl/VQS
2609.33855.paper_summary_zh: 自我進化的視覺-語言模型從未標記的圖像生成問題進行訓練。由於這些問題沒有金標答案，先前的方法通過對抽樣答案的多數投票或由模型評審進行標記。在人類評估中，我們發現自我進化過程中產生的多數投票標籤有24\%是錯誤的，而模型評審標籤則有18\%是錯誤的。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了可驗證的自我進化模型問答生成（VQS），這改變了模型評判答案的方式。模型不再對答案進行投票，而是將每個圖像解析為結構化記錄，例如場景圖、圖表或圖解。固定程序然後從記錄中寫出問題並計算其答案。模型仍然充當視覺檢查器，但它僅確認程序讀取的個別事實，一次一個簡短的主張。這些主張級別的檢查選擇了解析器的訓練目標，因此解析器在沒有標籤的情況下也能改善。人類評審者發現94\%的VQS答案是正確的，而多數投票的正確率為76\%。在十個基準測試中，VQS在2B、4B和8B規模上將Qwen3-VL的表現提高了最多3.18分，並在每個基準上超越了最強的自我進化基線。增益在三輪訓練中持續增長，在2B時達到3.84分。代碼已在 https://github.com/ahmedheakl/VQS 上發布。
